_about: SHELF of classical Arabic prose in English before 1931 that no other shelf held: de Slane's Ibn Khallikan (4 vols, 1843-71), Sprenger's Mas'udi, Meadows of Gold (1841), Hitti's Usamah (1929) and Baladhuri part I (1916) with Murgotten's part II (1924), and Chenery and Steingass's Assemblies of al-Hariri (1867, 1898). Lane's and Burton's Arabian Nights are on their own shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Beirut reprints of 1964-70 are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 71); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
